subject: math

objective.text: A liter is 1,000 milliliters. Split a liter into 10 parts of 100 milliliters, then 10 milliliters, then 1 milliliter.

explanations.title: Capacity
explanations.text: Capacity is how much liquid a container can hold. A swimming pool holds more than a glass.

explanations.title: A liter
explanations.text: A liter is a unit for an amount of liquid. We write it with a capital L.

explanations.title: Liquid volume
explanations.text: The amount of liquid is called liquid volume. We can split 1 liter into 10 cups of 100 milliliters.

explanations.title: Like the kilogram
explanations.text: 1 liter is 1,000 milliliters, like 1 kilogram is 1,000 grams. Each unit splits into 10 of the next smaller unit.

source_ref.section: Student Debrief and Problem Set Part 2

examples.title: Count the milliliters
examples.text: 10 cups of 100 milliliters: 100, 200, up to 1,000. 1,000 milliliters divided by 10 is 100 milliliters.

examples.title: Split 100 milliliters
examples.text: Pour 100 milliliters into 10 equal cups. Each cup has 10 milliliters. 100 divided by 10 equals 10.

questions.text: 1 kilogram is 750 grams and how many more grams?
Which has the smallest capacity: a swimming pool, a bathtub, or a glass?
We pour 1 liter into a container the size of a gallon jug. Does it hold less than, more than, or about 1 liter?
We pour 1 liter into a quart-size container. Does it hold less than, more than, or about 1 liter?
1 liter is poured into cups of 100 milliliters. How many cups are filled?
How many milliliters of water are in 1 liter?
Split 100 milliliters into 10 equal cups. How many milliliters are in each cup?
Cup K is marked at 100 milliliters. Cup L is marked at 10 milliliters. Why is Cup L's mark lower?
A dropper holds 1 milliliter. How many droppers full would fill 1 liter?
Morgan fills a 1 liter jar using a 100 milliliter cup. How many scoops does she need?
How many groups of 10 milliliters are in 1 liter?
One liter of water weighs 1 kilogram. How much does 1 milliliter of water weigh? Explain.
Mrs. Goldstein pours 3 juice boxes into a bowl. Each holds 236 milliliters. How much juice is in the bowl?
Daniel's tank holds 24 liters. His bucket holds 4 liters. How many buckets fill the tank?
How is splitting 1 liter like splitting 1 kilogram?
